messages:
sara: FYI nightly e2e shard-23 turned red around 06:12 UTC. failing test: session_reconnect.test.ts

jen: ack. can you paste the last-green commit?

sara: last green was 0a1b2c3 (yesterday 23:45). failures started after a few merges this morning, suspect one of them. logs below

sara: ```
[ERROR] session_reconnect.test.ts › reconnects after server restart
  Expected 1 to equal 0
  at Object.<anonymous> (tests/session_reconnect.ts:47:12)
  socket closed with code 1006
```

mike: i'll spin a bisect job. which shard exact?

sara: shard-23 (the nightly splits tests across shards, this one has the reconnect suite).

mike: running: `./scripts/run-bisect --range 0a1b2c3..HEAD --target tests/e2e/session_reconnect --shard 23 --ci`

ci-bot: bisect job queued: https://ci.internal/jobs/7329

mike: first pass finished. narrowed to a small range. bisect points to commit ee9f8a7 by @oliver (socket timeout tweak).

oliver: looking now. that change bumped default socket timeout from 2s -> 5s to reduce transient reconnects. weird that it would break reconnect test.

jen: can someone reproduce locally? if not, might be infra/shard config interaction.

mike: couldn't repro on my mac. reproduced on a linux ci-runner with docker image `redwood/e2e:ci-2026-03-16`. logs show timers skewing under load. snippet:

mike: ```
[INFO] test runner starting (concurrency=12)
[WARN] socket timeout reached after 5000ms (task queued)
[ERROR] reconnect count mismatch: expected=0 actual=1
```

sara: so probably increased timeout leads to overlapping reconnect logic under high concurrency on shard. we should either revert or change test harness to be robust.

jen: given nightly is a blocking signal for a lot of teams, let's revert ee9f8a7 temporarily while we investigate. mike can you open revert PR and tag release?

mike: will do. opening `revert: ee9f8a7 - socket timeout tweak` now. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pr/8120 (WIP)

mike: PR opened and CI running. requesting fast-track from @release. :pray:

ci-bot: PR 8120 CI: all checks passed. merge scheduled after approval.

oliver: i'll dig into a proper fix (maybe adjust the reconnect test or add backoff under high concurrency). sorry for the churn.

jen: thanks oliver. once revert is merged we'll re-run nightly and if green we'll follow up with a postmortem + action items (test hardening).

sara: revert merged and nightly rerun queued. monitoring.

ci-bot: nightly rerun for shard-23: https://ci.internal/builds/9021 (in progress)

mike: great job team. tagging this thread for follow-up: action items: 1) oliver investigte root cause 2) jen write test-hardening ticket 3) mike monitor next 3 nightlies.

sara: thanks all. :thumbsup:
